en: Rizal wrote the poem Mi Último Adiós while imprisoned in Fort Santiago before his execution.
Emilio Aguinaldo proclaimed Philippine independence from Spain on June 12, 1898, in Kawit, Cavite.
The Supreme Court of the Philippines is the highest court and consists of fifteen justices.
The Philippine eagle, also known as the monkey-eating eagle, is the national bird of the Philippines.
The Sinulog festival in Cebu honors the Santo Niño with a vibrant, rhythmic two-step dance.
The Ifugao people carved the famous Banaue Rice Terraces into the Cordillera mountains over 2,000 years ago.
Baybayin is an ancient pre-colonial Philippine writing system used by early Filipinos before the Spanish arrived.
Bayanihan is the traditional Filipino value of communal unity where neighbors help a family move their house.
Dr. Fe del Mundo founded the first pediatric hospital in the Philippines and invented a bamboo incubator.
Guillermo Tolentino sculpted the Bonifacio Monument in Caloocan and the Oblation statue for the University of the Philippines.
Mayon Volcano in Albay is famous for having the most perfect cone shape among all volcanoes worldwide.
The sampaguita, a fragrant white flower, was officially declared the national flower of the Philippines in 1934.
